svg.aria-label: Every design placed in space and time. Each panel is one design, in four columns by who decides: owner-decider, separate-decider, single-decider, and no-decider. Its rows are places: in a node, above SQL, below SQL, below the access methods, below the buffer pool. Its columns are four steps in sequence. S is the split joint, V the validation joint, R the replication joint, and a green band marks when the transaction executes, which has no fixed place. A purple strip marks when the commit version is fixed, which has no fixed place either. Owner-deciders split first, then validate and replicate; they fix the version after they validate, and in CockroachDB and Spanner validation first narrows it. Separate-deciders decide first: Calvin orders before it executes, then validates as it runs; DSQL orders after it executes, then validates; Oracle RAC validates while it runs, then orders. Single-deciders validate in the one writer while it executes, then order. No-deciders never validate or order: Cassandra and Riak split and replicate below their query language, and cr-sqlite replicates with no split. Below the key-value store, the no-decider column is empty.

Rows: where each step happens. Columns: in what order. Lines join the steps in sequence.
